transitions.description: Branded element (bird, light beam) passes in front of lens to transition between states.
Bright light pulse from product center triggers a scene state change.
Scene elements dissolve into particles, which reform into the next state.
Sequential product entries, each rise triggering the next after a settle delay.
Instant cut between clips. Use at clip boundary (end of 8s clip, start of 7s clip).
transitions.note: Preferred at LED 1 Curvo clip join — avoids transition artifacts.

transitions.description: Gradual opacity blend between states. Use only when visual language supports it.
